signals.title: Signal Scanner — 6-Point Confluence
signals.subtitle: 15-min bars · 4H regime · Scores update on Refresh
signals.thSpreadTip: Live bid-ask spread as % of mid (from snapshot quotes). Part of the round-trip cost: 2× taker fee + spread.
signals.thScoreTip: 6-point confluence score. ≥4 = BUY, 3 = half-size; ≤−3 shown as BEAR (shorts unsupported on Alpaca spot).
signals.thTrendTip: Score trend vs previous scan. ↑ improving, ↓ worsening, → unchanged.
signals.thAdxTip: ADX(14) trend strength — informational only, not scored. <20 ranging, 20–25 emerging, 25–40 trending, ≥40 strong.
signals.thObvTip: OBV volume-flow trend over 20 bars — informational only, not scored. Rising = accumulation, falling = distribution.
signals.thRegime4hTip: 4H EMA 20/50 regime. Golden = uptrend, Death = downtrend.
signals.thDailyTip: Daily regime gate. Uptrend = buys allowed.
signals.thAtrQtyTip: ATR-based suggested quantity using 1% equity risk rule. Requires account data loaded first.
signals.thNetRrTip: NET reward:risk — 4H swing-low stop vs BB-upper target, with the round-trip cost (2× taker fee + spread) subtracted from the reward leg. Entries below 1.0 are blocked, 1.0–1.5 half-sized (soft gate).
signals.thActionTip: Recommended action. BUY button pre-fills trade modal with ATR sizing.
signals.tablePlaceholder: Click Scan Now or Refresh to load signals.
signals.alertsDesc: Get a browser notification when any symbol hits score ≥ 4 (BUY) or ≤ −4 in downtrend (BEAR — informational, no short on spot venue).

scalp.title: ⚡ Scalping — Low-Timeframe Confluence
scalp.subtitle: Same 6-point engine as Signals, shifted to lower timeframes for short holds
scalp.descHtml: Execution / trend / regime timeframes shift down with the selector: 5 min → 5m·1h·4h, 15 min → 15m·1h·4h, 1 hour → 1h·4h·1D. Entry gate, regime gate and pills match the Signals tab (BUY ≥ 3.5, half ≥ 2.5). Scalps are faster and noisier — confirm before trading. Manual tickets only; no auto-trading.
scalp.notesDesc: Stops on scalps should sit below the recent low on the chosen timeframe. The portfolio swing-low stop (4H range low) still governs any position the scheduled bot or Autopilot opens — scalps you place here are managed manually.
scalp.thSpreadTip: Live bid-ask spread as % of mid. A scalp pays this on top of 2× the taker fee.
scalp.thAdxTip: ADX(14) trend strength on the exec timeframe — informational only, not scored.
scalp.thObvTip: OBV 20-bar volume-flow trend on the exec timeframe — informational only, not scored.
scalp.thCostCheckTip: Scalp viability gate: distance to the BB-upper target must be ≥ 2× the round-trip cost (2× taker fee + spread), or the move's edge is eaten by costs.
scalp.tablePlaceholder: Pick a timeframe and click “▶ Scan”.

settings.title: Settings
settings.labelMaxSymbols: Max Symbols in Market Signals scan

settings.showStableTitleAttr: Include stablecoin pairs (USDT/USD, USDC/USD, …) in the symbol dropdown
settings.watchlistNote: Used by Autopilot, Daily Journal, Signals tab, and Portfolio tabs. Changes take effect immediately after saving.
settings.prodNote: For a production setup, avoid calling Alpaca directly from browser-side HTML. Use a backend/proxy so your API secret is not exposed in the browser.
settings.engineIntro: These credentials are stored encrypted on the server and used by your scheduled jobs — they run even when this browser is closed. They are separate from the browser-only keys above, and are never sent back to the browser once saved.
settings.engineActivateLabel: Use this credential for my scheduled jobs
settings.engineLiveNote: 🔒 Live credentials are read-only: this project places orders on the paper account only. Replacing the credential in use, or disconnecting one, asks for your account password.
settings.engineConfigIntro: Only the settings you change, as a JSON object. Everything else uses the shipped defaults. Values outside the allowed range, unknown keys, and settings locked by the trading rules are rejected on save.
settings.engineKeysSummary: Show editable settings and their defaults
settings.engineNoneConnected: No credentials connected. Your scheduled jobs will not run until one is.
settings.engineNotConfigured: Server-side credential storage is not configured on this deployment, so credentials cannot be saved.
settings.engineSignIn: Sign in to connect credentials for the server-side trading engine.
settings.engineSignInSave: Sign in to save strategy overrides.
settings.engineNeedBoth: Enter both the API key id and the secret.
settings.engineConfigReset: Overrides cleared — using the shipped defaults.
settings.engineStale: Some saved settings are no longer valid and are being ignored by the engine:
settings.engineConfirmReplace: You are replacing the credential your scheduled jobs are using. Enter your account password to confirm.
settings.engineConfirmDisconnect: Disconnecting stops this account's scheduled jobs, including the stop-loss watchdog. Enter your account password to confirm.
settings.engineConfirmReset: Reset all strategy overrides back to the shipped defaults?
